resources.description: Auto-detect the mobile carrier for a phone number and return its live top-up amount range/denominations and current discount, before quoting or sending airtime. Wraps Reloadly's operator auto-detect. Run this (or POST /api/topup/quote directly, which auto-detects internally) before POST /api/topup.

Search Reloadly's gift card catalog (300+ brands, 14,000+ products/denominations across countries). Returns each product's id, brand, country, denomination range or fixed amounts, and sender fee/discount — everything needed to build a POST /api/giftcard/quote call.
